_comment: Chinese scam patterns, Simplified first with common Traditional spellings of the account-frozen lure (police/court impersonation, frozen account, verification-code theft, parcel and customs lures). Written by a non-native speaker from common phishing and smishing wording -- have a native speaker review before relying on them. Chinese has no spaces, so plain substring matching works without word boundaries. Generic words that appear in ordinary mail (a bare 'expiry date') are deliberately left out.
